title: ULTIMATE ANTI CRASH - Fifth Gear
summary: A Fifth Gear segment in which Tiff Needell tests autonomous emergency braking systems in the Mercedes S Class, Volvo V40 and VW up!. The cars are driven toward an inflatable dummy car to see how each system performs.
why: HN uses it as a real-world test of anti-collision systems in discussions of Tesla Autopilot and self-driving safety.

quote.text: Here's a road test, from 2013, of three anti-collision systems.[1]
